mismatches.text: I expected little, but the room was excellent.
mismatches.rationale: The negative expectation is background; the actual experience is positive.

mismatches.text: The battery no longer drains overnight; I am delighted.
mismatches.rationale: Negated problem and explicit delight convey improvement.

mismatches.text: The ticket cost more than before, and it was worth every naira.
mismatches.rationale: A higher price is factual context; the explicit value judgment is positive.

mismatches.text: Nothing about the visit disappointed me.
The app crashed three times while I was saving my work.
mismatches.rationale: Repeated task-blocking crashes imply dissatisfaction under the functional-failure rule.

mismatches.text: Great, another cancelled appointment after I waited all morning.
mismatches.rationale: Great conflicts with explicit cancellation and wasted time; context supports a negative reading.

mismatches.text: The update did not fix the login failure.
mismatches.rationale: The reported failure persists after an attempted fix.

mismatches.text: The download stopped at 90% on every attempt.
mismatches.rationale: Repeated inability to complete a download is a functional failure.
A timestamp alone does not express approval or disapproval.

mismatches.text: The receipt shows a charge of NGN 5000.
mismatches.rationale: A stated amount alone does not imply a value judgment.

mismatches.text: The tracking page now says delivered.
mismatches.rationale: A status message alone is not praise.

mismatches.text: The device has no headphone socket.
mismatches.rationale: A negated specification is not itself dissatisfaction.

mismatches.text: The interface looks great, but it is painfully slow.
mismatches.rationale: Design is praised and speed criticized.

mismatches.text: Setup was easy, but the connection drops often.
mismatches.rationale: Ease is positive; recurring disconnection is a functional failure.

mismatches.text: The repair worked, but the final bill was unreasonable.
mismatches.rationale: Successful repair and unreasonable cost are both evaluated.

mismatches.text: The form is easy to use, but it lost my saved entries.
mismatches.rationale: Ease is positive and data loss is an explicit functional failure.
